responsibility: This file implements comment capture and classification for the mc front end. It owns the concrete comment descriptor, accumulates raw comment text into DynamicStrings, classifies comments as procedure-heading, in-body, or after-statement based on lexer context and procedure-name matching, tracks one-time consumption of comments by later passes, and exposes helpers that return comment text in structured form, making it the subsystem that preserves source comments for AST attachment and pretty-printed output.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mcComment API from GmcComment.h with the concrete comment descriptor, dynamic-string accumulation, first-word procedure matching, classification logic, and one-shot consumption tracking. Unlike the header, it contains the state and rules that decide whether a comment is procedure-heading, in-body, or after-statement.
